a11yStatement:
Accessibility Statement

Wellgreens is committed to providing equal access to our website for all users, including those with disabilities. We have invested significant resources in making our site accessible and user-friendly for everyone.

Our Commitment

Wellgreens is committed to digital accessibility and aims to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA. Accessibility is an ongoing effort: we are continually working to improve the experience for all users and welcome feedback. Some content provided by third parties may not yet fully conform; please contact us using the details below if you encounter any barrier and we will work to assist you.

Accessibility Features

  • The site is adapted for common browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
  • Semantic HTML structure for assistive technologies and full keyboard navigation support.
  • Responsive design adapted for display on various devices (desktop, tablet, mobile).
  • Text size adjustment: Increase or decrease font size (80% to 200%) without affecting content layout.
  • Color and contrast options: Grayscale mode, high contrast mode, negative contrast (inverted colors), and light background mode.
  • Link highlighting: Visual highlighting of all links with underline and background color.
  • Title highlighting: Headings are highlighted with distinct background and text colors.
  • Readable font option: Switch to system fonts (Arial, Tahoma) for improved readability.
  • Large cursor: Enhanced cursor visibility for easier navigation.
  • Reading guide: Visual guide that follows the mouse cursor to aid reading.
  • Text spacing: Increased line height, letter spacing, and word spacing for better readability.
  • Text alignment: Options to align text left, center, or right.
  • Stop animations: Option to disable all animations and transitions for users sensitive to motion.

Contact Us & Accessibility Coordinator

If you encounter any accessibility difficulty while browsing our site, we would be happy to receive your feedback and assist you. Customer support covers orders, feedback, and store experience. You can contact our accessibility coordinator:

Name: Wellgreens

Customer support: support@wellgreens.store

Statement updated on: May 28, 2026
